title: Settings
subtitle: The store's operational configuration — what customers see, where you ship, how you tax, which languages you publish in.

store.title: Store details
store.intro: Who you are and how the store counts. These details appear on invoices, emails and the contact page, and set the currency, time zone and formats used across the admin.

shipping.title: Shipping
shipping.intro: Group the countries you ship to into zones, then decide which methods each zone offers and at what price. A country belongs to one zone only, so every customer sees exactly one set of options.

taxes.title: Taxes & VAT
taxes.intro: How VAT is charged and shown. Start with the store default, override it country by country, then add the rules for particular products and customers.

languages.title: Languages
languages.intro: The languages customers can shop and learn in, their order and the default — and what is still left to translate in each, one click from the editor.

currencyWarning.title: Existing prices won't be converted.
currencyWarning.body: Product and shipping prices keep their amounts in the new currency. Past orders keep the currency they were paid in.

order.title: Order number format
order.hint: Applies to new orders only. Existing order numbers never change.
order.tip: Order numbers are what customers quote when they contact you. A short prefix makes them recognisable in an inbox; the next number must be higher than any existing order.

hours.title: Support availability
hours.hint: When your team answers messages and calls. Shown on the contact page.

shipping.zonesHint: Each zone lists its countries first, then the methods customers there can choose.
shipping.restOfWorldLine: Every country not listed in another zone
shipping.noRates: No shipping method yet — customers here can't check out.
shipping.noCountries: No countries — this zone applies to nobody yet.
shipping.inactiveZone: Switched off: customers in these countries can't check out until the zone is on again.
shipping.inactiveWorld: Switched off: countries outside your other zones can't check out.

issues.title_other: {{count}} zones can't be used at checkout
issues.noRates: {{zone}} is on but has no shipping method.

empty.title: No shipping zones yet
empty.body: Create a zone for the countries you ship to, then add at least one shipping method so customers can check out.

kindHint.standard: Your everyday tracked delivery at a fixed price.
kindHint.express: A faster option customers pay more for.
kindHint.free: Offered automatically once the basket reaches an amount.
kindHint.pickup: Customers collect their order from the studio, free of charge.

checker.title: Check a destination
checker.description: See exactly what a customer in a given country is offered, including unsaved changes.
checker.via: {{country}} is in {{zone}}. Customers there can choose:
checker.viaWorld: {{country}} isn't listed in a zone, so {{zone}} applies:
checker.noZone: No zone covers {{country}} — customers there can't check out.
checker.inactive: {{country}} is in {{zone}}, which is switched off — customers there can't check out.
checker.noRate: {{country}} is in {{zone}}, but no method is switched on — customers there can't check out.

confirm.zoneBody_one: Customers in its {{count}} country will no longer be able to check out unless another zone covers them. Its {{rates}} shipping methods are deleted with it. You can still discard this before saving.
confirm.zoneBody_other: Customers in its {{count}} countries will no longer be able to check out unless another zone covers them. Its {{rates}} shipping methods are deleted with it. You can still discard this before saving.
confirm.rateBody: Customers in {{zone}} will no longer see this option at checkout. Orders already placed keep the shipping they paid for.

toast.zoneDuplicatedBody: The copy starts switched off and without countries — choose them now.

zoneSheet.description: A zone is a group of countries that share the same shipping methods and prices.
zoneSheet.name: Zone name
zoneSheet.nameHint: For you only — customers never see it.
zoneSheet.restOfWorldHint: Covers every country not listed in another zone.
zoneSheet.restOfWorldTaken: {{name}} already covers the rest of the world.
zoneSheet.restOfWorldBody: This zone catches every destination your other zones don't list. Switch it off to ship only to the countries you name.
zoneSheet.activeHint: When off, customers in these countries can't check out.

rateSheet.name: Name at checkout
rateSheet.nameHint: What customers read when choosing how to receive their order.
rateSheet.optional: Optional — the order amount above which this method becomes free.
rateSheet.freeFromHint: Free shipping appears at checkout from this basket total.
rateSheet.pickupFree: Pickup is always free for the customer.
rateSheet.conditionsHint: Leave empty for no limit. The method only appears when the order matches.
rateSheet.activeHint: When off, it is kept but hidden at checkout.

taxes.enabledOn: VAT is calculated on every order using the rules below.
taxes.enabledOff: No VAT is added to orders.
taxes.disabledBody: Only do this if your business is not VAT-registered. Your rates and rules are kept and come back when you switch VAT on again.
taxes.disclaimer: Rates shown are examples for this prototype. Confirm every rate and rule with your accountant before going live.

tier1.title: Store default
tier1.caption: Applies everywhere, unless a country has its own rate.

tier2.title: Country rates
tier2.caption: Replace the default for customers in these countries.

tier3.title: Advanced rules
tier3.caption: Adjust the rate for particular products or customers.

precedence.title: How VAT is chosen at checkout
precedence.body: The country rate wins over the default when one exists; advanced rules then lower or remove it for specific products and customers.
precedence.default: {{country}}: {{rate}} — no country rate, the store default applies.
precedence.export: {{country}} is outside the EU: exports are usually zero-rated when the export rule is on.
precedence.off: VAT is switched off — no VAT is charged.

default.title: Default VAT
default.description: The rate and display rules used whenever nothing more specific applies.
default.countryHint: Where your business is registered for VAT.
default.rateHint: The standard rate of that country.
default.pricesIncludeHint: The prices you enter on products already contain VAT.
default.showProductHint: Adds “incl. VAT” or “excl. VAT” under every price.
default.showCheckoutHint: Lists the VAT amount as its own line in the basket and on the receipt.

tips.pricesInclude: Turn this on if the price you type on a product is the price the customer pays. Turn it off if you type prices before tax and want VAT added on top.
tips.display: Consumers in the EU must see prices with VAT included. Show them excluded only if you sell mainly to businesses.
tips.vies: VIES is the European Commission's service that confirms a business VAT number is valid. Checking it protects you when you don't charge VAT to a business.
tips.exempt: Some customers must not be charged VAT — businesses in another EU country with a valid VAT number (reverse charge), or orders shipped outside the EU. The customer's situation is checked at checkout.
tips.basis: The address used to choose the VAT rate. For sales to consumers in the EU, the rate of the delivery country normally applies.
tips.rounding: Per line rounds VAT on each product, then adds the lines up. Per order adds everything up first, then rounds once. The result can differ by a cent.
tips.reduced: Some products are taxed at a lower rate in some countries — books or certain training, for example. Each reduced rate applies to one category in one country.

example.label: Example
example.enteredGross: You enter {{price}} on a product (VAT included).
example.enteredNet: You enter {{price}} on a product (before VAT).
example.checkoutHidden: The VAT line is hidden at checkout.

rates.title: VAT rates by country
rates.description: Countries not listed here use the store default ({{rate}}).
rates.rateHint: The country's standard VAT rate, in percent.
rates.fallback: Inactive and unlisted countries fall back to the store default of {{rate}}.
rates.emptyBody: Every order uses the store default. Add a rate for each country with a different VAT rate.
rates.dialogBody: Customers delivered to this country are charged this rate instead of the store default.
rates.activeHint: When off, the store default applies to this country.
rates.deleteBody: Customers in this country will be charged the store default ({{rate}}) instead. Past orders keep the VAT they were charged.

reduced.title: Reduced VAT rates
reduced.description: Lower rates for particular product categories, country by country.
reduced.addBody: Applies to products of this category delivered to this country.

b2b.title: Business customers & VAT numbers
b2b.description: Let professional customers identify their business at checkout.
b2b.collect: Ask for a VAT number at checkout
b2b.collectHint: An optional field for customers buying as a business.
b2b.validateHint: Numbers are checked before the order is placed.

exempt.title: Tax-exempt customers
exempt.description: Orders that are not charged VAT, and why.

reverseCharge.label: EU businesses with a valid VAT number
reverseCharge.hint: Reverse charge: the customer accounts for VAT in their own country. Needs VAT numbers at checkout.

export.label: Orders shipped outside the EU
export.hint: Exports are zero-rated; local import taxes may apply on delivery.

trainingBodies.label: Approved training organisations
trainingBodies.hint: Only for organisations whose exemption you have verified and recorded.

calc.title: Tax calculation
calc.description: Which address sets the rate, and how amounts are rounded.
calc.shippingHint: Shipping is taxed at the same rate as the products in the order.

enabled.title: Enabled languages
enabled.description: Available to customers, in the order of the storefront's language menu. Drag a row, or use the arrows, to reorder.

lang.defaultNote: The default language can't be disabled. Choose another default first.
lang.detectHint: First-time visitors see the storefront in their browser's language when it is enabled.
lang.fallback: Fall back to the default language
lang.fallbackHint: Untranslated fields show in {{name}} instead of appearing empty.
lang.disableBody: {{name}} will no longer be available to customers. Its pages, products, trainings and emails stop being published, and customers who chose {{name}} will see {{fallback}} instead.
lang.disableKeep: Translations are kept. Enable the language again to bring everything back.
lang.defaultBody: {{name}} becomes the language new visitors see first, and the one used when a customer's language isn't available.
lang.defaultWarning: {{percent}}% of content is translated in this language. Untranslated fields will show the original English.
lang.defaultSource: Content is still written in English and translated from it — only what customers see first changes.

toast.enabledBody: Nothing is translated yet. Save to make it available to customers.

coveragePanel.title: Translation coverage
coveragePanel.description: Share of content translated into every enabled language, by type.

tr.title: Missing translations
tr.description: Everything customers would see untranslated. Pick an item and translate it in place — the list updates as you save.
tr.untracked: {{names}}: nothing translated yet. Content is shown in the default language until translations are added.

allDone.title: Everything is translated
allDone.body: Every enabled language is complete. New content will appear here as soon as it needs translating.

noMatch.title: Nothing matches these filters
noMatch.body: Try another language or content type, or clear the filters to see everything that is missing.

editor.description: Translate side by side with the English original. Missing fields are highlighted.

editor.outdated: The English changed on {{date}}, after this was translated.

editor.reviewMany_other: {{count}} fields were translated before the English changed.
